not_changed.finding: Placement test UTME, opus, too-narrow at set-drama: the four prescribed-text parents split by genre slot, so a question that does not name its text (Q10, Q31, Q78, Q2, Q28) can be given a subtopic kind but not a parent; the ingest step needs to carry the title, or plot, characters, themes, setting and style should be shared facets.
